feature: Explicit authorized execution of saved pending numerical jobs
behavior: Gateway submissions and start execute explicitly selected job IDs rather than draining older queued work.
Start rechecks current actor/workspace/site/mode/toolkit and calculation policy, execution hooks, dependencies and saved argument schema.
Pending/running repeats do not duplicate a calculation; terminal or interrupted jobs cannot restart.
Private input reads check ownership, pending state, envelope, operation, size, finite JSON and unsafe input keys, with fixed errors.

browser.gateway: Real managed gateway, persistent SQLite job store, encrypted vault and actual numerical subprocess worker
browser.setup: Two pending heat-loss jobs were persisted with the original session before a new gateway opened their store.
journey: Signed in through production web UI.
Clicked Start queued job on one record.
Observed Running without Start, then refreshed and observed Completed with result controls.
Neighboring record remained Pending with Start.
browser.cleanup: Owned browser tab closed, viewport reset, gateway/web stopped and disposable state/credentials removed.

workers.assignment: Targeted queue and private saved inputs

review: Primary owned authorization, runtime queue lifecycle, contracts, gateway, MCP, SDK and web route integration.
Primary batches accepted IDs within the manager selection bound100.
Primary reviewed private input finite-value checks and the platform fallback.
Initial web build found stale compiled SDK types; SDK build followed by serial production web build/check passed.
Primary strengthened saved-schema denial and no-queue assertions.
SDK acceptance permits an already completed native calculation to reject start and verifies completed status, avoiding a race with the actual worker.
Runtime and manager share one selection-bound constant.
limits: Synthetic inputs qualify actual native calculation and product behavior, not a physical energy installation.
Unsupported-platform private-file fallback was reviewed in source; Windows execution was not qualified.
This does not satisfy broad actual-agent evaluation, outside contribution, sustained operations or a coherent final platform release.
qualification_status: Local acceptance and matching published CI passed.
